verdict.rationale: Stripe's own docs publish a headline coverage figure: users can search "more than 12,000 supported banks." The pack has no first-party statement of which countries are covered, though community comments say it is US-only. There is also no institution list or lookup to check against where your users bank. Missing for 10: first-party geography/country coverage documentation, a published per-institution coverage list or search tool, coverage breakdowns by connection type or data feature, independent corroboration of the 12,000 figure.

support.subject: As a founder, the platform documents how many institutions it reaches and where — published coverage numbers and geographies I can check against where my users actually bank

citations.quote: Users select their bank from frequently chosen institutions or by searching more than 12,000 supported banks.
